content.text: {"what_it_is":{"claims":[{"text":"Operational Enhancements is a procurement program run by U.S. Special Operations Command (SOCOM), funded through the Procurement, Defense-Wide account.","citation":{"fact_id":"82319d60fd00326c"}},{"text":"The program's detailed justification is classified: the budget narrative states only that 'Details provided under separate cover.'","citation":{"fact_id":"7e5c6d893517b1e1"}},{"text":"Part of the program's funding covers Overseas Operations Costs (OOC). The FY 2026 base budget includes $28.044 million in such costs; FY 2024 included $34.635 million in OOC execution and FY 2025 included $29.111 million in OOC enactment.","citation":{"fact_id":"94cb7b9a9ef4ae75"}}]},"why_it_matters":{"claims":[{"text":"For fiscal year 2026, the program requests $352.100 million in discretionary funding plus $42.901 million in mandatory (reconciliation) funding, for a combined total of $395.001 million.","citation":{"fact_id":"80ed416a795a4f24"}},{"text":"The $42.901 million reconciliation portion is described as being detailed under Section 20010 (Readiness) of the Reconciliation Exhibit.","citation":{"fact_id":"35fcc061de8b1c49"}},{"text":"The discretionary request for FY 2026 is $352.100 million (in USD thousands, $352,100).","citation":{"fact_id":"62cab8b2fcc562e6"}},{"text":"In FY 2024 the program recorded actual spending of $322.341 million ($322,341 thousand), providing a baseline for measuring growth.","citation":{"fact_id":"94cb7b9a9ef4ae75"}},{"text":"FY 2025 enacted funding was $331.592 million ($331,592 thousand), an increase over FY 2024 actuals.","citation":{"fact_id":"155025c1dcecdd09"}},{"text":"The FY 2026 total request of $395.001 million represents a further increase over the FY 2025 enacted level.","citation":{"fact_id":"b801a53f1f90844c"}}]},"players":{"claims":[{"text":"Lobbying filings from the Boeing Company in 2024 referenced 'enhancements' in the context of corporate and aviation
